visual.title: Message
visual.text:
Hello Greg,

We are comparing your two offers for SMS appointment reminders. Our current provider's contract ends on 2026-03-31.

Two questions before we decide:
1. Does the two-year term allow a price review after twelve months?
2. Can the sender name show each clinic's name?

An answer by 2026-03-11 lets us sign this week.

Megan
